title: feat(widget): rename rangeRatings to starRatings + design improvements

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @vvo to be a potential reviewer
Small change: it should be StarRating I believe, not StarRatings? see https://www.google.com/search?q=react+star+%22ratings%22

cc @dzello Can you help naming the widget shown in the description:

- `<StarRating/>`
- `<StarRatings/>`
- ?

I put an `s` because it's a list of ratings (and not only a single line of stars).
But I'm fine with starRating if everybody agree :)

> I put an s because it's a list of ratings (and not only a single line of stars).

Yes same, I just want to ensure we are not doing bad english here :8ball:

I think the singular version works best. There are multiple star ratings but we are filtering by the (singular) star rating of the record. Also as a umbrella term for the concept of rating by stars, the singular form works better. This is my best attempt to explain, I hope it makes sense!
